evidence.title: GitHub - BankkRoll/tweet-to-code: Starting a journey picking designs to turn to code from twitter

name: Tweet to Code
summary: shadcn registry of React components recreated from tweet designs, installable with the shadcn CLI.
description: A design-to-code registry that turns UI designs posted on X/Twitter into ready-to-use React components, installed with the same CLI flow as shadcn/ui. Components are responsive, support light/dark themes and are attributed to their original designers; the repo is MIT-licensed while the designs remain with their creators. The site itself is bot-walled, so its gallery could not be read.
contains: registry of components recreated from tweet designs
